title: SEM Experiment — Draft-07
description: Demo schema for JSON Schema Draft-07. Highlights: 'definitions' vocabulary, 'dependencies' keyword for conditional required, and items-array tuple syntax. $ref siblings are silently ignored in this draft. (exclusiveMinimum/exclusiveMaximum are standalone numbers here too -- the boolean modifier form was removed in Draft-06.)

DeviceModel.title: Device Model
DeviceModel.description: SEM device model used in the experiment.

Operator.title: Operator Name
Operator.description: Full name of the operator running the instrument.

SEMParameters.title: SEM Parameters
SEMParameters.description: Acquisition parameters set on the instrument.

AccelerationVoltage.title: Acceleration Voltage [kV]
AccelerationVoltage.description: Draft-07: $ref is evaluated in isolation. Sibling keywords (type, minimum:10 here) are silently ignored — only the $defs/voltage schema is applied.

ProbeCurrent.title: Probe Current [nA]
ProbeCurrent.description: Draft-07 exclusive bound: 'exclusiveMinimum' is a standalone numeric keyword (same as 2019-09/2020-12). Value must be strictly greater than 0.

BeamEnergy.title: Beam Energy [eV]
BeamEnergy.description: Draft-07 exclusive bound on the upper side: 'exclusiveMaximum' is a standalone number. Value must be strictly less than 30000. 'multipleOf' constrains the value to increments of 100.

WorkingDistance.title: Working Distance [mm]
WorkingDistance.description: Distance from the final lens pole piece to the specimen surface. Providing this field makes ProbeCurrent required (see 'dependencies' on the parent object).

ProbeDiameter.title: Probe Diameter [nm]
ProbeDiameter.description: Estimated diameter of the electron probe at the specimen surface. Plain inclusive minimum — in Draft-07, omitting 'exclusiveMinimum' (or setting it to false) leaves 'minimum' inclusive by default.

DetectorMode.title: Detector Mode
DetectorMode.description: Secondary electron (SE), backscattered electron (BSE), or STEM detector mode.

SampleLabel.title: Sample Label
SampleLabel.description: Alphanumeric identifier for the sample. Pattern enforced via regex.

ScanSequence.title: Scan Sequence (Tuple)
ScanSequence.description: Draft-07 tuple syntax: 'items' accepts an array of schemas. Each array position is validated against its positional schema. Position 0 = dwell time, 1 = line count, 2 = direction.
